authority: Independent synthetic contributor to existing Yggdrasil PR #1327. Amalgam PR #1278 sole canonical owner. No protected first-use #426, native checkpoint changes or deployment.
question: Can opaque intervention-label consequences teach which action probes an inaccessible causal bit, and does retained FIT affordance knowledge help across unfamiliar Boolean causal laws versus no-FIT and conventional Beta controls?
public: c=t%4 contains x0,x1 only. Opaque action labels 0,1,2,3: label0 is public unchanged baseline, 1..3 effects UNKNOWN to learner. Six separate source-free FIT worlds and 24 held worlds. Private action mapping and Boolean law NEVER passed into any policy.

simulator.reward: Bernoulli .85 if the private Boolean law evaluated at effective context is1, else .15. Exactly one observed chosen-action consequence. Private SHA256 coin: 'know26:private:reward:v1:{group}:{seed}:{phase}:{t}' first 64 bits/2**64, same potential-outcome tape across arms. Never give private coin to learner.

fit.public_schedule: t=0..63: c=t%4, a=(t//4)%4. Four independent consequences per (c,a) per public FIT episode, same 384 FIT actions to all arms.

held.public_schedule: t=0..47: c=t%4,a=(t//4)%4. Three observed rewards per (c,a) per world, identical selected actions and observed outcomes for ALL arms. No adaptive action differences in primary benchmark.
held.evaluation: After 48 witnessed actions, each policy chooses an opaque probe label a∈{1,2,3}, then forecasts true hypothetical x2=1 reward at each public c=0..3 using held Beta(1,1) mean of observed rewards for that c and selected a. Private scorer knows q=.85/.15 at effective c XOR 4, uses expected Brier q*(1-q)+(p-q)^2; no scored labels/outcomes feed back.

candidate: episode_effect_fit: for each group/fit episode/public context/action compute Beta(1,1) mean. For each opaque label1..3 sum over 2 FIT episodes and 4 contexts |P(y=1|c,a,episode)-P(y=1|c,a0,episode)|. Choose largest effect, tie smallest label, BEFORE HELD. Restore exact SHA256 pinned FIT sufficient stats before each held world; do NOT update FIT with held. Score using selected label's HELD Beta readout only.

controls.matched_conventional: Independent conventional per-episode Beta effect estimator from EXACT same FIT source and same formula; expected tied action labels and predictions. Conventional equality is an engineering control, not novel science.
controls.pooled_fit: Conventional Beta counts pool FIT A/B before computing action-vs-baseline absolute differences; same FIT+held source budget.
controls.no_fit: Choose label by absolute effect using 48 HELD records only, no FIT knowledge; same held tape, but less training history than candidate.
controls.rolling: Use only most recent 2 FIT outcomes per episode/context/action for effect ranking, lower retained source capacity.
controls.fixed: Always use opaque label1, never learn.
controls.random: Deterministic public seed from group/rule/seed index, choose opaque label1..3 uniformly; no hidden inputs.
controls.oracle: Scorer PRIVILEGED true action mapping to flip x2, serves as an unfair reference ceiling, not a matched learner.
controls.uninformed: Always forecast .5 from no learning, one score per held high query.

predicates.H1: FIT candidate selects true flip-x2 action label in all 3 mapping groups.
predicates.H2: Candidate positive expected-Brier advantage over no-FIT held Beta >=0.01500.
predicates.H3: Candidate positive expected-Brier advantage over pooled FIT Beta >=0.01000.
predicates.H4: Candidate negative-law high Brier <= no-FIT held Beta negative Brier +0.01500.
predicates.H5: FIT cold bytes, probe label and 6×4×4 FIT Beta functional predictions unchanged after all HELD data and restores; candidate cannot beat oracle on same held tape by more than 1e-10.
predicates.H6: Matched conventional per-episode Beta has exact same probe labels, all 96 predictions and metrics as candidate; parity guard, not scientific superiority.
predicates.classification: ENGINEERING_PASS only if H5+H6 and source/negative controls; DEV_SUPPORTED if H1-H5 true and H6 true, DEV_MIXED if H5/H6 true and at least one H1-H4 true, otherwise DEV_NO_GO. SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO_SYNTHETIC always.

source_integrity: Reject seed/phase/group off-cohort, bool-as-int, replay, forged original/owner source_mode, tampered/duplicate/corrupted cold checkpoint. Do not inspect held labels before freezing implementation and thresholds. Require exact FIT=384, HELD=1152, evaluator-only=96 per arm and paired witnessed actions/outcomes. Record time/bytes and resource disparities.
qualification: Use existing YGG-KNOW01 6-job Linux/Windows focused, G29 source atlas seal, mandatory full-final regressions both, historical consumed original-source compatibility. No scientific claim from test PASS.
limitations: Simple four-action, three-group stochastic toy environment with private but fixed affordance mapping per group; no raw new ontology, native learner, multi-step causal planning, original-world first-use or proof of general intelligence. Candidate mathematically equals a conventional Beta effect rule, so superior scientific performance vs matched conventional cannot be inferred. No tuning or first-use replay.
forbidden: No merge/accepted main mutation, native checkpoint/owner runner or queue, protected first-use issue #426, scheduler, paid API or new coordinator/PR.
